title: Lamar Jackson: I won't think about my legacy until I start thinking about retiring

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson: I won't think about my legacy until I start thinking about retiring
sources.description: "That's a good question," Jackson said when asked about his legacy. "I really don't have an answer for that question. I was not expecting that. I really don't think about my legacy."
